detailed_descriptions.en: ICBM: Escalation is a grand RTS game that plunges players into the high-stakes world of global warfare, where every decision could tip the balance between survival and annihilation. Command vast armies, develop cutting-edge technology, and wield the most devastating weapons ever created to ensure your faction’s supremacy. Whether by conventional forces or through nuclear firepower, you’ll need to conquer or obliterate your enemies to secure dominance in a volatile global arena. CONVENTIONAL & NUCLEAR WARFARE Take charge of a continent-spanning faction and build up an unstoppable military force. Construct a nuclear stockpile, research groundbreaking tech, and deploy a combination of nuclear submarines, strategic bombers, and intercontinental ballistic missiles to cripple your adversaries. But nuclear warfare is not the only path to victory. ICBM: Escalation introduces new victory conditions that emphasize conventional warfare, allowing players to invade enemy territory, weaken their resources, and force their surrender through tactical superiority. The two new modes, Standoff and Conquest, add fresh layers of strategy and pacing compared to the high-speed Blitz Mode, which returns as the most similar mode to the original ICBM. RESEARCH & DIPLOMACY Progress through multiple technological eras, from early Cold War advancements to near-future innovations, including stealth warships and space-based weapon systems. The revamped diplomacy system adds new layers of intrigue, allowing players to form research agreements, negotiate ceasefires, and broker deals over captured territories. World-spanning diplomatic measures, such as international treaties banning specific weapons, offer fresh strategic possibilities that can reshape the course of global conflict. MULTIPLE GAME MODES ICBM: Escalation offers a variety of modes that cater to different playstyles. Standoff mode delivers a balanced escalation from conventional skirmishes to full-scale nuclear war, while Conquest mode emphasizes long-term strategy, brinkmanship, and tactical mastery. For players seeking faster-paced action, Blitz Mode focuses on direct, rapid nuclear confrontation, staying true to the spirit of its predecessor. The game also features a rich single-player campaign that spans decades of history, beginning with the Korean War and leading into speculative future scenarios where your decisions shape the outcome of global conflict. In multiplayer, face off against up to 10 players, competing for dominance in a highly competitive environment with rankings and ELO systems. KEY FEATURES A deadly mix of conventional and nuclear warfare High replayability with diverse strategies and unit options Devastating weapons of mass destruction, including chemical bombs and MIRVs A detailed 3D map featuring hundreds of cities and strategic targets Dynamic diplomacy, allowing players to shape the world order Multiplayer mode supporting up to 10 players with ranked competitive play Single-player campaign with historic and futuristic missions Full modding support for community-created content
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: ICBM: Escalation是一款大型RTS游戏，玩家将置身危机重重的世界战争世界中，每一个决定都会影响到生存与毁灭的平衡。指挥大量军队，发展前沿科技，使用有史以来最具破坏性的武器来保证你的派系霸权。使用常规部队和核武器等一切手段，征服或消灭你的敌人，从而保证自己在全球舞台上的主导地位。 常规战争&核战争 掌管横跨大陆的派系，建立一支势不可当的军事力量。建立核储备，研究突破性技术，部署核潜艇、战略轰炸机和洲际弹道导弹来削弱对手实力。但核战争并非胜利的唯一手段。ICBM: Escalation引入了新的胜利条件，提高了常规战争的战略意义。玩家将可以入侵敌方领土，掠夺对方资源，通过战术优势迫使对手投降。与迅捷的闪电战模式相比，新增的对峙和征服模式加入了更多战略与节奏层次，回归到与初代ICBM类似的玩法模式。 研究&外交 从冷战早期到近未来创新，科技发展跨越多个时代，包括隐形军舰和太空武器系统。修改后的外交系统引入新的谋略层级，玩家将可以达成研究协议，进行停战谈判，并交易己方占领的领土。覆盖全球的外交措施（如禁止特定武器的国际条约)为游戏提供了重塑全球冲突进程的全新战略可能性。 多种游戏模式 ICBM: Escalation内含横跨不同风格的游戏模式。对峙模式对常规冲突及全面核战争进行了升级，而征服模式则更强调长期战略、边缘政策和高超的战术水平。对于寻求快节奏行动的玩家来说，闪电战模式侧重于快速直接的核对抗，将前作精神贯彻到底。游戏还有内容丰富的单人战役，时间跨越几十年历史，从朝鲜战争直到未来场景推演，你的决定将影响全球冲突格局。在多人游戏模式下，你将与至多10名玩家进行激烈的角逐，通过排名和ELO系统争夺游戏的主导地位。 关键特征 常规战争与核战争的致命结合 多种策略和可选单位提高可重复游玩性 游戏中包含强力破坏性武器，包括化学炸弹和多弹头独立重返大气层载具等大规模杀伤性武器 包含数百个城市与战略目标细节的3维地图 塑造世界秩序的动态外交 多达10名玩家的多人排位模式 兼具历史和未来任务的单人战模式 支持多种Mod，保证自定义内容
